placements.why: The content establishes an organizational category for operational readiness practices: rollback rehearsals governed by cadence, grounded in the principle that an unrehearsed rollback is one you do not have. This names an organizational-strategy area nothing existing covers.
placements.title: Operational readiness as practiced discipline
placements.theme: Operational readiness is not a declared state but a rehearsed practice — capabilities unexercised are capabilities unpossessed.

placements.title: Rehearsed rollbacks are the only rollbacks you have
placements.theme: A rollback capability exists only insofar as it is rehearsed; monthly cadence converts a theoretical rollback into an operational one.
placements.why: src-2 directs monthly Atlas rollback rehearsals; src-3 supplies the principle that an unrehearsed rollback is one not actually possessed; src-4 and src-5 record the cadence and owner of the decision. Together they support the thematic principle that rollback readiness requires rehearsal cadence — a directional statement true beyond these specific words.
